source_terminology.target_order_reference: original per-language exposure stream, not identical training padding/dropout

six_group_representation_semantics: Post-attention residual includes previous residual; post-MLP residual includes attention and previous residual. Groups are feature sites, not causally isolated functions. Weighted protection does not guarantee matched gradient norms.
kd_metadata_interpretation: Common audited trainer internally calls old_mode full_feature to schedule the extra backward. KD has zero feature layers; uses dense teacher logits and capability-normalized KL(Base||student), not hidden-state MSE. Top-level final mode records kd. Additional teacher manifest listed separately.
official_ar_ru_Global_MMLU: Both available at pinned SW revision, 14042 test questions / 57 subjects each; official dataset source https://huggingface.co/datasets/CohereLabs/Global-MMLU
